operations.title: Positive theta density does not by itself imply xi Stieltjes positivity
operations.statement: For the normalized theta even moments, complete monotonicity of R=d/dx log Xi(i sqrt x) begins with m4<=3m2^2 and m6-15m2m4+30m2^3>=0. A positive even three-atom measure violates the first inequality for epsilon<1/3, with smooth positive approximations preserving failure. Thus positivity/evenness are insufficient; the desired spectral measure is a nonlinear log-cumulant transform requiring stronger source structure.
operations.scope: Exact low-order hierarchy and general counterexample; does not falsify the Riemann theta kernel or prove its full Stieltjes property.

operations.title: Theta log-cumulant Stieltjes gate
operations.description: Expand the squared-variable logarithmic derivative in normalized even moments and test alternating signs; compare against an explicit positive even counterexample.
